content.value_statement: Textbook chatbot projects need clear backend, retrieval, and interface requirements. This skill provides a concise blueprint for a RAG chatbot using Qdrant and a responsive chat interface.
actual_capabilities: Describes a chat API route that accepts a query and conversation history.
Outlines embedding, Qdrant retrieval, context construction, and response generation steps.
Documents a suggested Qdrant collection and its text, source, and chunk identifier fields.
Lists chat interface features, including resize controls and Markdown responses.
Notes selected-text questions, responsive design, profile-aware answers, and theme support.
limitations: It is an architecture guide and does not create application files.
It does not provide implementation code, tests, or deployment steps.
It does not define authentication, authorization, or data-retention controls.
It leaves the embedding provider, model selection, and collection configuration open.

use_cases.title: Plan a learning assistant
use_cases.description: Use the guide to define a chatbot that answers questions from textbook material.

use_cases.title: Review retrieval design
use_cases.description: Compare an existing RAG flow with the documented embedding, search, and context stages.

use_cases.title: Scope chat interface work
use_cases.description: Use the listed interface features to plan responsive chatbot components and styling.

prompt_templates.title: Understand the architecture
prompt_templates.prompt: Explain the chatbot architecture in this skill in simple steps.

prompt_templates.title: Plan the API flow
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an implementation checklist for the chat API route, from query input through response generation.

prompt_templates.title: Design Qdrant retrieval
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to propose a Qdrant retrieval flow for textbook chunks. Identify assumptions that need confirmation.

prompt_templates.title: Review production readiness
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this RAG chatbot plan for missing security, privacy, evaluation, and operational requirements.

output_examples.input: What does the backend do after it receives a question?
output: Embed the question with the selected embedding model.
Search Qdrant for relevant textbook chunks.
Build context from the matches and generate a response.
A floating chat window with size controls.
Responsive layout, profile awareness, and dark or light theme support.

best_practices: Confirm access control and privacy requirements before using profile data or textbook content.
Evaluate retrieval relevance with representative textbook questions before release.
Show source information with answers so learners can verify the context.
anti_patterns: Do not treat the guide as complete production code.
Do not expose unrestricted vector search or chat endpoints without authorization controls.
Do not rely on generated answers without checking retrieval quality and source accuracy.

faq.question: Does this skill implement a chatbot?
faq.answer: No. It documents the proposed backend, retrieval, and interface design.

faq.question: Which vector database does it describe?
faq.answer: It describes Qdrant for storing and searching textbook embeddings.

faq.question: What data fields are suggested?
faq.answer: The guide lists text, source, and chunk identifier fields for textbook chunks.

faq.question: Which model provider should I use?
faq.answer: The guide mentions Gemini or OpenAI options but does not select or configure a provider.

faq.question: Does it include authentication controls?
faq.answer: No. It notes profile-aware answers but does not specify authentication or authorization implementation.

faq.question: Can I use it with Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. Claude Code can use the guide to discuss and plan the described chatbot architecture.
